market_pulse.theme: Regulatory crackdown and legal changes across multiple jurisdictions
market_pulse.narrative: A wave of new regulations, enforcement actions and tax adjustments is sweeping the iGaming landscape, with countries such as Thailand, Bangladesh, Ireland, Kenya, Mozambique and Ukraine tightening rules, targeting illegal operators, and revising licensing frameworks.

Operators and technology providers are announcing a series of collaborations – from jackpot platforms (Super + ThrillTech) to AI data services (Vyking Ventures + PlayAIO) and platform roll‑outs (EveryMatrix lottery division, BetAhoy partnership) – signalling a push for product differentiation and market expansion.

market_pulse.theme: Growth of prediction markets and new entertainment‑driven betting formats
market_pulse.narrative: Prediction markets are moving from niche to mainstream, with major brands (Meta) planning dedicated apps, crypto‑focused platforms (Crypto.com) reshuffling leadership, and entertainment‑driven events such as Love Island driving new audience participation.

market_pulse.theme: New market entries and regional launches
market_pulse.narrative: Operators are gearing up for launches in emerging regions – Alberta’s iGaming launch, expanding sports betting in Africa, and regulatory‑driven opportunities in Germany and Mozambique – highlighting the continued geographic diversification of the industry.
Regulators across Europe, Africa and the UK are increasing budgets, issuing court rulings and targeting illegal gambling operators, signalling tighter compliance environments for iGaming firms.
